task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! First step, head north. And then, make an effort to move east. After that, try to venture south. Once you manage that, attempt to venture south. With that done, travel east. And then, make an effort to move north. After that, pick up the fondue from the bench. And once you've done that, you win!
description:
You make a grand eccentric entrance into a cookery.

You can see a cabinet. The light flickers for a second, but nothing else happens. What a letdown! The cabinet is empty!

There is an exit to the east. Don't worry, it is unguarded. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unblocked.

thought: I should go north as the first step of the exploration.
feedback:
You arrive in a canteen. A typical one.

You see a rack. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. You can make out a platter. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. What, you think everything in TextWorld should have stuff on it? You make out a pan. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the pan.

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going east. You don't like doors? Why not try going south, that entranceway is unblocked.
